en.t: No, no, it is really no trouble at all...

units.source_text: 老头像是忽然变成了乐善好施的人，嘴里喋喋不休地说着，

en.t: The old man, as if he had suddenly turned into a generous and helpful person, kept chattering away,

units.source_text: “就像您所看到的，这里是个贫穷的小村子，也没有您瞧得上眼的建筑。

en.t: As you can see, this is a poor little village, and there are no buildings here worthy of your notice.

units.source_text: 只要您觉得可以的话，打听打听跑跑腿儿什么的，我都可以帮你的忙。”

en.t: If you find it acceptable, I can help you with things like asking around or running errands.
